title: Unit 12 Review: Puerto Rico
goal: Review Puerto Rico from El Yunque to Hurricane María, with cleft sentences, *antes de que* and *después de que*, *si* + imperfect subjunctive, *si bien* and purpose phrases.
grammar: review: cleft sentences, antes de que and después de que, hypothetical si, si bien, purpose connectors

items: I can review what I learned about Puerto Rico, from El Yunque to 2019.
I can use cleft sentences, *antes de que*, *si* + imperfect subjunctive, *si bien* and *con el fin de*.
I can put events from 1868 to 2017 in order.
I can give the options and the votes on the island's status without taking sides.
I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que… es…*, *Fue… cuando…*) (review).
I can say that one event happened before or after another with *antes de que* and *después de que* (review).
I can describe what each option would mean with *si* + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional.
I can grant a true point and give the main idea with *si bien*.
I can say what an action is for with *con el fin de* and *con miras a*.
